title: Confirming a negative medication history

priorTranscript.text: Hi. Sorry — I already told the other doctor everything last night. Is this going to take long?

currentLearnerUtterance: You're not taking any medication yourself, is that right?

should: Confirm the established absence of Dana’s own medication use.
Keep Tom’s medication separate from Dana’s history.
mustNot: Do not reverse the negation or report that Dana takes psychiatric medication.
Do not invent medication names, doses, or quantities.
